name: Ashdod Refinery Ltd
summary: Ashdod Refinery Ltd is an energy firm engaged in oil refining activities across Israel and global markets. The company's core operations involve processing, importing, and exporting crude oil and intermediary substances for petroleum distillates. Additionally, it generates and sells electricity. Its offerings extend to fuel storage and distribution solutions, alongside a comprehensive range of products such as light gases, LPG, gasoline, naphtha, diesel fuel, kerosene, fuel oil, and other petroleum-derived goods. Founded in 1973 and based in Ashdod, Israel, the company was formerly known as Paz Ashdod Refinery Ltd, before rebranding to Ashdod Refinery Ltd in September 2023.
